---
title: "reveal.js features under Quarto"
format:
  revealjs:
    width: 1280                      # Presentation Size
    height: 720
    slide-number: c/t                # Slide Numbers
    show-slide-number: all
    navigation-mode: vertical        # Vertical Slides: level-1 headings start a column
    controls-layout: edges
    jump-to-slide: true              # Jump to Slide (G)
    preview-links: true              # Links / Lightbox-style iframe previews
    lightbox: true                   # Quarto's image lightbox (GLightbox)
    parallax-background-image: apps/explorer.png
    parallax-background-size: "2560px 1440px"
    revealjs-plugins:                # Creating a Plugin: a local Quarto extension
      - ping
resources:
  - media/
  - apps/
---

## Markup and raw HTML {#markup}


## Last {#last}

```{=html}
<script>
  // postMessage replies need this; no YAML option.
  window.addEventListener("load", () => Reveal.configure({ postMessageEvents: true }));
  // Keyboard: Quarto's YAML only takes keyboard: true/false, so custom keys go through the API.
  window.addEventListener("load", () => Reveal.addKeyBinding({ keyCode: 88, key: "X", description: "Next slide" }, () => Reveal.next()));
</script>
```
